name: Bleeds Real Blood
source:
Fleche bleeds real blood, despite being a doll.  When it's not in use, it waits in the closet for its owner to cut its flesh and drink its blood. But sometimes she makes it wait for a very long time, especially now that she's met a new girl.

[From [url=https://jammyjams.itch.io/bleeds-real-blood]itch.io[/url]]
